text:
anya: quick sync — ran AWQ int8 weight-only + microbatch "sink-kv" packing experiment on prod-sim today, sharing numbers and oddities.

devon: nice — what are p50/p95 and regression risk vs GPTQ baseline?

anya: p50: 38ms -> 31ms (-18%), p95: 142ms -> 118ms (-17%) with group_size=64 + microbatch=4 + kv-sink enabled. overall token throughput +12%.

liam: curious about packing overhead — did you see more unpack/fallbacks?

anya: yes — kernel-chooser fell back to generic int8 kernel on ~12% of requests. root cause: pack boundaries misaligned for some prefixes so we couldn't use the optimized AWQ path and paid an unpack+repack tax.

sophia: quality numbers on eval suite? any regression vs FP16 or GPTQ-int8?

anya: AWQ-int8 (group 64) vs FP16: token-error +0.6%, BLEU -0.8. vs GPTQ-int8 baseline: AWQ shows +0.2% token-error. small but trackable.

devon: calibration overhead? boot/load latency changes?

anya: calibration default uses 1024 samples -> model load +0.9s. doing stratified 128-sample quick-calib reduces load to +0.15s but increases quality delta ~+0.15% on token-error. tradeoff.

liam: KV-sink impact: traces show ~18% fewer pack ops for hot prefixes when kv-sink enabled. mem overhead ~+2% on allocator.

anya: profiler snippet (top-level):
```
pack_cpu_total_ms: 84
awq_kernel_time_ms: 920
generic_int8_overhead_ms: 280 (due to fallbacks)
kv_pack_ops: 72 -> 59
```

sophia: interesting. did you try prefetch alignment or group-size autotune?

anya: tried two mitigations: 1) prefetch alignment (align microbatch start to pack boundary) -> fallback rate down 9%; 2) kernel_affinity flag: prefer awq kernel when request.group_size % 16 == 0 -> fallback down to ~6%.

devon: lazy calibration on first N requests? could avoid long load times but risky for cold quality.

anya: considered lazy-calib hybrid: quick 128-sample calibrate on load, then background expand to 1024 using real traffic; abort if eval hooks detect >1% delta.

liam: logs from a single trace: `trace-id=abc123 pack_triggered=1 fallback=0 p50=28ms p95=104ms` — looks like ideal path. another trace where misalign: `trace-id=def456 pack_triggered=1 fallback=1 unpack_penalty=42ms p95=162ms`.

sophia: can we add automated regression checks? e.g., per-commit perf run + eval pass threshold.

perf-bot: CI job created: #ci/awq-int8-microbatch-kv-sink — https://ci.internal/12345 :white_check_mark:

anya: next steps: 24h canary at 5% traffic, add telemetry for pack-fallback counts and unpack_penalty distribution, open PR for kernel_affinity + prefetch alignment patches. I'll own canary+telemetry.

devon: sgtm. assign owners?

anya: @liam takes pack profiler and allocator impact, @sophia takes eval thresholds and automated checks. I'll push PR for runtime flags.

liam: command to reproduce locally: `./scripts/run_perf.sh --model=llama-2-13b --quant=awq-int8 --group-size=64 --microbatch=4 --kv-sink=true`

sophia: add an eval harness run after canary start and ping once daily.

anya: will do. filing tickets and PRs now, linking them to the CI job. ping me if you want raw traces. :thumbsup:
